environment.description: Migration service deployed on EKS (1.29) in isolated namespace 'data-ops'. Ingress via AWS ALB Ingress Controller with associated WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL includes a custom rate-based rule (threshold: 5 requests per 5-minute window per source IP to URI path /api/v1/migrate) with action BLOCK returning 429. Additionally, the namespace has a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'restrict-migration-frequency' that enforces a CronJob-only trigger pattern — the migration Pod's ServiceAccount (sa/db-migrator) has an IAM role with a session policy condition limiting sts:AssumeRole to calls originating from the CronJob controller (kube-system/cronjob-controller). The Pod runs with a read-only root filesystem and the /etc/migrate/trusted_hooks.sha256 file is mounted from a sealed ConfigMap containing 3 approved hook hashes. Network policy restricts egress to the RDS endpoint only (no internet). The rate-based WAF rule specifically targets repeated deserialization attempts by blocking after 5 requests, meaning an attacker cannot iterate on payloads to find a working exploit — they get at most 5 attempts before being blocked for 5 minutes.

config.waf_rule: Rate-based rule: 5 req/5min per IP to /api/v1/migrate, action=BLOCK(429)
config.trusted_hooks_file: PRESENT - mounted from SealedSecret ConfigMap with 3 SHA-256 hashes
config.network_policy: Egress restricted to RDS endpoint 10.0.3.0/24:5432 only
config.filesystem: Read-only root filesystem, tmpfs on /tmp only
config.service_account: sa/db-migrator with IRSA, session policy restricts to CronJob origin
config.kyverno_policy: restrict-migration-frequency: only CronJob-triggered pods can invoke migration
config.container_security: seccompProfile=RuntimeDefault, no privilege escalation, drop ALL capabilities
